questions.prompt: How many games did the 1972–73 Philadelphia 76ers win?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the 76ers lost their remaining 13 games to finish 9–73.

funFacts.text: Philadelphia lost its first 15 games before the season unraveled further.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the 76ers lost their first 15 games of the season

funFacts.text: Veteran Hal Greer was the last holdover from the 1967 championship team and retired after the season.

funFacts.text: The Sixers had offered the coaching job to both Al McGuire and Adolph Rupp, but each declined.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)

questions.prompt: What was Dikembe Mutombo's rebounding average after joining the 2000–01 Sixers?

questions.prompt: After trading for Rasheed Wallace, how many of its final 19 games did Detroit win?
questions.note: Sixteen wins in the final 19 games helped lock in Detroit's playoff form.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: With the addition of Wallace, the Pistons won 16 of their final 19 games

funFacts.text: Rasheed had played just one game for Atlanta before being moved to Detroit in the middle of the season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the team acquired All-Star forward Rasheed Wallace from the Atlanta Hawks after playing just one game for them.

funFacts.text: The Pistons had to recover from a dangerous deficit against New Jersey in Game 6 to stay alive in the Eastern playoffs.
